parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of wrong legend values for large ranges by incorporating the offset value from the `ScalarFormatter`. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch does not account for the rcParam settings `mpl.rcParams['axes.formatter.useoffset']` and `mpl.rcParams['axes.formatter.offset_threshold']`, which may affect the behavior of the offset value.
The code could be slightly more readable by adding a comment explaining the purpose of the offset handling.
